major.summary: Preview UI state is retained across project changes.
major.evidence: GrowthPreviewWorkspace owns showAll, query, and selectedId with no reset keyed to projectId or a new response. GrowthPreviewPage changes only the React Query key; React can retain the mounted workspace while its data prop changes. No test exercises a project-ID transition.
major.impact: A project switch can carry the previous filter and selected-page state into the next project scope, directly violating acceptance criterion 8 even though this fixture currently has identical page IDs.
major.recommendation: Key/reset the workspace state by projectId (or explicitly reset it when scope changes) and add a component-level regression test proving no query or selected state survives a project transition.

major.summary: The launcher source allowlist can copy arbitrary untracked secret-bearing files from src or public.
major.evidence: isGrowthPreviewSource returns true for every path whose first segment is src or public except a small extension denylist. copySource enumerates untracked files with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard and copies their working-tree contents. For example, src/private.txt or public/token.json is accepted; tests cover only selected extensions and dotfiles.
major.impact: The supposedly credential-free disposable launcher can inherit local secrets or state placed in otherwise allowed directories; a copied public file can also be served by the preview app.
major.recommendation: Use an explicit source-file allowlist/extension policy sufficient for the app snapshot, or reject untracked files and narrowly enumerate required untracked checkpoint files; add regression cases for arbitrary secret-named files under both src and public.

verification_gaps.summary: Required interactive browser acceptance remains unverified.
verification_gaps.evidence: The authoritative verification record states that final mobile, expanded-provenance, empty-state, reset/retry, and uninterrupted keyboard flows are not accepted as verified; browser screenshots contradicted preceding DOM state. Current render tests are static SSR checks and presentation tests are pure helper tests.
verification_gaps.impact: The required behaviour for working filtering/reset, pending/error retry, keyboard access, and mobile detail access lacks reliable end-to-end evidence, so this preview checkpoint cannot be accepted on the stated UI criteria.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Resolve or replace the unstable browser harness with reliable component/browser interaction tests, then capture fresh mobile, empty/reset, retry, keyboard, and expanded-provenance evidence.

do_not_change: Keep the response fixture-only and independent of real project content, repositories, providers, models, and persistence.
Keep requireProjectContext on the server function and preserve the existing authorized project shell.
Keep the route read-only, the sample disclosure prominent, and selected-change history explicitly partial and non-causal.
Do not change detector thresholds, evidence-packet semantics, URL normalization, auth policy, schema, dependencies, or provider behavior for this preview checkpoint.
